description: Agent Web Research — Search attributed global news and OpenAlex research; optionally read a supplied public HTML page once to extract evidence, confirm reachability and fingerprint its content, compare an earlier semantic hash, and extract up to three text-only pages from a public PDF. One payment for the composed response; URL inputs are optional and unavailable evidence is reported. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

page_url.description: Optional public HTTPS HTML page for extract, source-verify and page-change

pdf_url.description: Optional public HTTPS selectable-text PDF, maximum three pages and 2 MiB

previous_hash.description: Optional prior 64-character semantic SHA-256 hash, requires page_url

name: api_agent_web_research
